UPDATE agp.WARP_MEMBER_COUNTS
SET DATE_SENT_TO_WARP = (select sysdate FROM dual)
WHERE RUN_DATE = @V_RUN_DATE AND PULLED_DATE = @V_PULLED_DATE

UPDATE AGP.WARP_MEMBER_COUNTS_ZIP
SET DATE_SENT_TO_WARP = (select sysdate FROM dual)
WHERE DATE_SENT_TO_WARP IS NULL

UPDATE agp.WARP_MEMBER_COUNTS
SET DATE_SENT_TO_WARP = (select sysdate FROM dual)
WHERE RUN_DATE = @V_PULLED_DATE

UPDATE agp.WARP_MEMBER_COUNTS
SET DATE_SENT_TO_WARP = (select sysdate FROM dual)
WHERE RUN_DATE = @V_RUN_DATE

SELECT  SUM([COUNT]) + SUM(ISNULL(LAPSECOUNT,0))+ SUM(ISNULL(SALESCOUNT,0)) AS FAC_COUNT  
  FROM dbo.WARP_MEMBER_COUNTS a
  WHERE a.BATCH_ID = @0

SELECT SUM(CAST(a.SUBS_CNT AS INT)) AS FILE_COUNT
  FROM dbo.STAGE_MEMBER_DETAIL a
  WHERE a.BATCH_ID = @0

SQL_RUN_DATE_GET_WARP_DATA.defaultValue: 'select COUNT_ID, GRGR_CK, GRGR_ID, CSCS_ID, CSPI_ID, PDPD_ID, COUNT, PULLED_DATE, DATE_SENT_TO_WARP, RUN_DATE,SALES_COUNT,LAPSE_COUNT, RPAD(ZIP,9,'0') AS ZIPCODE, INVALID_ZIP \nFROM AGP.WARP_MEMBER_COUNTS_ZIP \nWHERE RUN_DATE = TO_DATE('1/1/1900', 'mm/dd/yyyy HH:MI:SS AM')'

SQL_PULLED_DATE_GET_WARP_DATA.defaultValue: 'select COUNT_ID, GRGR_CK, GRGR_ID, CSCS_ID, CSPI_ID, PDPD_ID, COUNT, PULLED_DATE, DATE_SENT_TO_WARP, RUN_DATE,SALES_COUNT,LAPSE_COUNT, RPAD(ZIP,9,'0') AS ZIPCODE, INVALID_ZIP \nFROM AGP.WARP_MEMBER_COUNTS_ZIP \nWHERE PULLED_DATE = TO_DATE('1/1/1900', 'mm/dd/yyyy')'

SQL_DEFAULT_GET_WARP_DATA.defaultValue: 'select COUNT_ID, GRGR_CK, GRGR_ID, CSCS_ID, CSPI_ID, PDPD_ID, COUNT, PULLED_DATE, DATE_SENT_TO_WARP, RUN_DATE,SALES_COUNT,LAPSE_COUNT, CONT_COVRGE_COUNT, RPAD(ZIP,9,'0') AS ZIPCODE, INVALID_ZIP \nFROM AGP.WARP_MEMBER_COUNTS_ZIP \nWHERE DATE_SENT_TO_WARP IS NULL'

SQL_GET_WARP_DATA.defaultValue:
'select COUNT_ID, GRGR_CK, GRGR_ID, CSCS_ID, CSPI_ID, PDPD_ID, COUNT, PULLED_DATE, DATE_SENT_TO_WARP, RUN_DATE,SALES_COUNT,LAPSE_COUNT, RPAD(ZIP,9,'0') AS ZIPCODE, INVALID_ZIP 
FROM AGP.WARP_MEMBER_COUNTS_ZIP 
WHERE DATE_SENT_TO_WARP IS NULL 
AND PULLED_DATE = TO_DATE('1/1/1900', 'mm/dd/yyyy')
AND RUN_DATE = TO_DATE('1/1/1900', 'mm/dd/yyyy HH:MI:SS AM')'
